## ValueTypes variable

The value-type constructors, as one namespace so generated code can alias it (`const t = ValueTypes`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
ValueTypes: ValueTypeConstructors
```

## Example

```ts
const t = ValueTypes
const Status = t.enumeration(['confirmed', 'tentative', 'cancelled'])
const Update = t.record({ id: t.string(), status: t.optional(Status) })
const result = Update.encode({ id: 'E1', status: 'confirmed' })
```
